evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3428323 ($50.01, product R, online) scores 0.78 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.23.
Card baseline from 21 earlier transactions: median $27.58, 95th percentile $100.08; the flagged amount is 1.8x the median.
Device profile 'Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 65.0 | 1920x1080' was not used by this card before; identity record marks it New.
Simulated customer validation: Cardholder states they did not make this transaction and still has the card.
Card-not-present fraud from a new device: as above, with the identity record marking the device New for this account, sometimes behind a proxy.
Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.
